title: QUIZ - 42
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Finding the Input from a Known Output
questions.learningObjective: Work backwards through a sequence of operations to find the original input
questions.question: A machine's rule is: multiply the input x by 3, then add 8. If the output is 47, what was the input?
questions.explanation: Reversing the operations: subtract 8 from the output (47 - 8 = 39), then divide by 3: 39/3 = 13.
questions.hint: Work backwards through the operations, undoing each one in reverse order.

questions.learningObjective: Write an algebraic expression representing a sequence of input operations
questions.question: An input-output machine multiplies the input n by 3 and then subtracts 19. Write an algebraic expression for the output.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the input by 3 gives 3n; subtracting 19 afterward gives 3n - 19.
questions.hint: Translate each operation in the order it is applied to the input.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate the output of a described sequence of operations for a given input
questions.question: A machine takes an input t, multiplies it by 5, then adds 9 to produce the output. What is the output when the input is 12?
questions.explanation: Output \(= 5 \times t + 9\). Substituting t = 12: \(5 \times 12 + 9 = 69\).
questions.hint: Apply the operations in the order described: multiply first, then add.
